# DealWise

> Smart price comparison and deal discovery platform for Indian shoppers. Compare prices across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and more, scan barcodes, search visually, and earn Deal Coins rewards.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of DealWise, daily deals, and featured products.
- [Features](/features): Multi-platform comparison, price tracking, smart analysis, and notifications.
- [Search](/search): Search products and compare prices across stores.
- [Visual Search](/visual-search): Upload a product image to find matches and best prices.
- [Barcode Scan](/scan): Scan product barcodes for instant price comparison.
- [Coupons](/coupons): Verified discount codes across categories.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to using DealWise.
- [About](/about): Mission, story, and team behind DealWise.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the DealWise team.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/sign-in): Existing user login.
- [Sign Up](/sign-up): Create a new DealWise account.
